ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface, contrasted by low-intensity black pixels localized to the trailing edge perimeter and the peduncle insertion point.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white blob covering the central lobes; thin, irregular low-intensity black band following the trailing edge contour; a vertical low-intensity wedge at the ventral center/peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 45-50 degrees; notch depth is roughly 15% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the interior trailing edge; transitioning to low-frequency, high-amplitude irregular jagged peaks at the distal lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves extending from the median notch, tapering to sharp lateral points at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of high-contrast dark circular pixels on the distal edge of the right lobe, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal linear pixel disruption oriented from the upper-left toward the lower-right on the surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small irregular indentations and 'chips' along the trailing edge boundary; prominent dark mottling and skin texture disruptions at the peduncle base.
other_distinctive_markers: Numerous specular highlights across the ventral surface caused by adhering water droplets reflecting light.
